hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then black "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.css || "$f" == *.js ]]; then npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
